name: Rite of Vision
summary: At Bloodhoof Village, young tauren drink the Water of the Seers and glimpse the path before them. A spectral guide rises beside the tribal bonfire.

sections.title: The Water of the Seers
sections.body: After gathering the ritual herbs and passing the first trials of faith, you receive the Water of the Seers from Zarlman Two-Moons. You drink it before the tribal fire at the heart of Bloodhoof Village. Keep your mind focused and respectful, and the sacred water opens your sight beyond the physical world. It joins the material and spiritual realms.

sections.title: Following the Ghost Wolf
sections.body: Once you drink the brew, an ancestral ghost wolf appears in the flames. It neither speaks nor fights, but lopes northwest across Mulgore's rolling plains. Follow its quiet path away from the village and into the rocky hills. There, the hermit Seer Wiserunner waits in secluded meditation.

sections.title: A Walk to Wisdom
sections.body: The vision ends when you reach Seer Wiserunner at the mouth of his mountain cavern. The walk across grassy hills tests your patience, your trust in ancestral guidance, and your attunement to the Earth Mother. Pass the rite, and you earn the right to face the Rite of Wisdom, the ultimate test of adulthood.

faq.q: What happens when I drink the Water of the Seers?
aliases: how does water of seers work
faq.answer: When you drink the Water of the Seers near Bloodhoof Village's tribal fire, your spiritual senses open. Soon, a ghost wolf appears before the flames to guide you.

faq.q: Where does the spirit guide lead me?
aliases: who does the wolf lead to
faq.answer: The spectral wolf leads you northwest from Bloodhoof Village, across Mulgore's hills and to a rocky cave where Seer Wiserunner dwells.

aliases: who gives the rite of vision
faq.answer: Zarlman Two-Moons is a tauren shaman in Bloodhoof Village who prepares initiates for spiritual adulthood through ancestral rites and sacred concoctions.
Seer Wiserunner is an elder tauren mystic who lives in contemplation among the cliffs northwest of Bloodhoof Village. Initiates who follow their spirit vision find him and finish the trial.

faq.q: Why must the water be drunk near the tribal fire?
faq.answer: Bloodhoof Village's tribal bonfire anchors its ancestral spirits. Its consecrated flames and the holy water together let the vision cross into the waking world.

faq.q: What rite comes after the Rite of Vision?
aliases: next quest after rite of vision
faq.answer: After you complete the Rite of Vision with Seer Wiserunner, you undertake the Rite of Wisdom, the final spiritual trial of your early journey in Mulgore.

angles.text: As a young tauren, you enter adulthood through the sacred Rite of Vision. It shows your communion with your ancestors and your obedience to spiritual guidance.
As a shaman, you learn early to walk between worlds by following an ancestral spirit wolf. The rite grounds your bond with the spirits that guide the Horde.
As a druid, you deepen your reverence for the natural world and your spiritual humility before the guidance of animal forms.
